headline: Quadra Legal advises Wipro on majority stake acquisition in Dermatouch
sum: Wipro Consumer Care & Lighting has acquired a 60% majority stake in Dermatouch, at an enterprise valuation of ₹387.5 crore. Quadra Legal advised Wipro on this acquisition.
detail: Wipro Consumer Care & Lighting has acquired a 60% majority stake in Dermatouch, at an enterprise valuation of ₹387.5 crore. Quadra Legal advised Wipro on this acquisition. The transaction was led by Kaushalya Venkataraman (Founding Partner), with support from Samiksha Sisodiya (Partner), Associates Bharath Pottekkat and Abhishek Vishwanath. Dermatouch Dermatouch is a premium skincare brand offering dermatology-backed solutions across acne care, pigmentation, scars, dark circles, and dry and sensitive skin.
